findings.title: Potential Accidental Data Deletion

findings.fix:
Add validation to ensure the directory exists and prompt for confirmation before deletion. Example:

```bash
if [ -d "$DIR" ]; then
  read -p "Are you sure you want to delete all files in $DIR? (y/n) " confirm
  if [ "$confirm" = "y" ]; then
    rm -rf "$DIR"/*
  else
    echo "Operation cancelled."
  fi
else
  echo "Error: Directory $DIR does not exist."
fi
```
